name: MSA-SimNorm: temp + per-position re-weight
tagline: Group-wise softmax with a tanh-bounded learnable temperature in [0.5, 1.5], multiplied by softplus per-position weights, then renormalized to a (scaled) simplex.
diff_from_baseline: Adds two learnable knobs to the simnorm baseline: a single bounded temperature (tanh-clipped to [0.5, 1.5]) on the softmax logits, and a softplus per-position weight initialized so weights start near 1; after weighting the output is renormalized so each group remains on a (scaled) simplex.

name: Adaptive SimNorm: per-dim bias + temperature
tagline: Per-position learnable bias added to the logits and exp(log_temp) per-position temperature, then standard group softmax.

key_hyperparams.name: log_temp
key_hyperparams.role: per-position log temperature, exp() before division

init_recovers: Standard SimNorm exactly at init (b=0, T=1)
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the simnorm baseline, adds two learnable per-position vectors (length=simnorm_dim) — an additive bias on the logits and a per-position exp(log_temp) divisor — leaving the within-group softmax simplex projection unchanged.

name: GatedSimNorm: simplex x sigmoid mean gate
tagline: Standard group softmax multiplied elementwise by sigmoid(mean_d(x_g) + 2.0), so each group can be turned off when its average logit is small.
init_recovers: Standard SimNorm scaled by ~0.88 at init (when all gates open)
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the simnorm baseline, multiplies each group's softmax output by sigmoid(group mean logit + 2.0) so the model can dynamically gate inactive groups; the simplex shape is preserved but each group is no longer constrained to sum to 1.

name: Entmax-1.5 + spherical mix
tagline: Group-wise sparse entmax(alpha=1.5) blended with a per-group L2-normalized centered direction, with the mix gated by a confidence sigmoid.

key_hyperparams.name: mix
key_hyperparams.role: max share of the spherical direction path

init_recovers: Sparse entmax variant of SimNorm when the spherical share alpha = 0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the simnorm baseline's softmax with entmax(alpha=1.5) (sparse simplex) and blends it with a per-group L2-normalized centered direction; the blending weight is a sigmoid of (max-mean) of the group logits scaled by 1.25 and capped at 0.35. No learnable parameters.

name: Centered hybrid SimNorm + L2 with global norm
tagline: Subtract sigmoid-weighted group mean, blend group L2 with temperature-softmax via learnable alpha, multiply per-position weight, then global L2 + scale.
formula: $$\tilde x_g = x_g - \sigma(\theta_c)\,\overline{x_g},\;\; T=\mathrm{clip}(\theta_T, 0.1, 10),\;\;\alpha=\sigma(\theta_\alpha)$$ $$z_g = w\odot\Big[\alpha\,\mathrm{softmax}(\tilde x_g/T) + (1-\alpha)\,\tfrac{\tilde x_g}{\|\tilde x_g\|_2}\Big]$$ $$y = \theta_s\,\frac{z}{\|z\|_2}\quad\text{(global L2 over the full latent)}$$
init_recovers: Approximately a sigmoid(0.6) blend of (centered) SimNorm and group-wise L2, then global L2
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the simnorm baseline with a much heavier hybrid: subtract a sigmoid-weighted group mean, run two parallel paths (group-wise L2 and temperature-softmax), blend with a sigmoid alpha, multiply by a per-position weight vector, then apply a global L2 over the full latent and a scalar scale. All five mixing knobs are learnable.
